title: SSH terminal-only serialization benchmark comparison
what: flatwire mean decode throughput (MB/s) or its speedup ratio vs json-std / cbor-fast

reader_questions.question: Which serialization library decodes fastest and how fast is it?
reader_questions.expected: flatwire leads at ~1413 MB/s (4.5× json-std and 1.55× cbor-fast).

reader_questions.question: Is flatwire's decode lead outside run-to-run spread?
reader_questions.expected: Yes; flatwire (~1,425 ± 29 MB/s) is separated by >500 MB/s from runner-up cbor-fast (~912 ± 22 MB/s).

reader_questions.question: What is the payload-size tradeoff of choosing flatwire over proto-lite?
reader_questions.expected: flatwire payloads are 148.2 kB vs proto-lite's 96.4 kB (+54% larger, though still smaller than json-std at 174.5 kB).
